mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to compressed discount rates on equity cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.5% in the past month
failure_condition: In non-tightening regimes, the FEDFUNDS crossing above 3.5% does not predict negative returns, or returns are not significantly negative when it occurs (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward trend in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (e.g., correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO) is below 0.5, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive when the interaction occurs (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment rates below 4.0% in a labor market expansion regime reflect strong labor demand, fostering economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In non-expansion regimes, UNRATE <4% does not correlate with positive returns, or in expansion regimes, returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in labor participation (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor markets, boosting productivity and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not show a sustained upward trend over the past month, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS trends upward (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) above its 1-month high signals robust production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The crossing does not occur, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive when it does (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates a virtuous cycle of economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 up and UNRATE down is weak (e.g., correlation <0.3), or 20-day returns are not significantly positive when the combination occurs (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% during a contractionary monetary phase signals tighter policy, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.5% in contractionary regime
failure_condition: In contraction phases, FEDFUNDS do not rise above 3.5%, or returns are not significantly negative when they do (p>0.05).
